|game_text=If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2). [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history={{Card errata/Twilight Is Upon Me (V)}}
The Players Committee changed “Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1” to “Your personal Force generation = 2,” and added the Personal Force icon. A power bonus for occupying Endor or Death Star II battlegrounds replaced Luke’s once-per-game relocation. The [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)|Set 22 original]] preserves the earlier wording.

File:V22-L-twilightisuponme-2024-12-29-change-crop-after.png|Players Committee erratum
</gallery>
This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]] (version 2 of 2). It is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]]): the card image documented in the repository (1 October 2023)<ref name="ht-2494181">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/hires/twilightisuponme.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023.</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-867258b">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/867258b968f0fccc370675c2054109eabd4d35f8 swccg-card-json commit 867258b] “Set 22” (1 October 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
*: The same card face was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; creation metadata 6 October 2023).</ref>, page 4, with the same words. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and that card image are one version on [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]]; the former page ''Twilight Is Upon Me (V) (Errata)'' redirects there.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/hires/twilightisuponme.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2). [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-e1137c3">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/e1137c35d73827551e0f70f68c2e8da6ea8beb6a swccg-card-json commit e1137c3] “More cards and fixes” (15 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1.” became “Your personal Force generation = 2.” (and the card gained the Personal Force icon); the once-per-game move-phase relocation of Luke was replaced by “Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2).” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
